Terms of use

Last updated: November 3, 2026

These terms apply to Passport Office Finder (passportofficefinder.com). By using the site you accept them. They are short because the site is simple: it publishes free information and does not sell anything.

What the site is

Passport Office Finder is an independent directory about passport acceptance facilities and passport agencies in the United States, edited by Agustín Mendez (Pinamar, Argentina). It is not an official website and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to the U.S. Department of State, any passport agency or any acceptance facility. Official names and logos belong to their owners and are mentioned only to identify the services described.

Information, not official advice

Content is general information compiled from public official sources, with the source and date shown where possible. Addresses, hours, fees and requirements change without notice. Check with the official office or website before you travel, pay or submit anything. Nothing on the site is legal, financial or professional advice.

We do not process applications

We cannot book appointments, file applications, check the status of a case or take payments. Any page or person that asks you for money in the name of this site is not us.

Advertising

The site may show ads served by Google AdSense. Ads are marked as such and are chosen by Google, not by us. Showing an ad does not mean we recommend the advertiser.

Links to other websites

We link to official websites and, sometimes, to other useful pages. We do not control them and are not responsible for their content, availability or privacy practices.

Use of the content

You may read, print and share pages for personal use, and quote short parts with a link to the source page. Copying the site or large parts of it, or reusing it automatically, is not allowed. Official data remains the property of the bodies that publish it.

Errors and liability

We work to keep every page accurate and we correct errors when they are reported. Even so, we cannot guarantee that all information is complete or current. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for losses caused by relying on it. If you find a mistake, please tell us at contact@passportofficefinder.com.

Changes

We may update these terms; the date at the top shows the current version. Related pages: privacy policy, cookie policy, about and contact.
